record.edic_text:
2304 theios {thi'-os}

from 2316; TDNT - 3:122,322; adj

AV - divine 2, Godhead 1; 3

1) a general name of deities or divinities as used by the Greeks
2) spoken of the only and true God, trinity
   2a) of Christ
   2b) Holy Spirit
   2c) the Father

same.cexp: 憎恨神的；被神憎恨的（#羅 1:30|）
